title: Minimal phenomenal experience is selfless, timeless and aperspectival

statements.text: Minimal phenomenal experience is non-egoic self-modeling: atemporal, selfless and not tied to an individual first-person perspective. It lacks minimal phenomenal selfhood, time representation and a spatial frame, yet it has representational content and a phenomenal character of its own, combining the absence of subject-object structure with transparency.

sources.quote: MPE is non-egoic self-modelling: as such it is atemporal, selfless, and not tied to an individual first-person perspective.
MPE is aperspectival and it does not instantiate MPS, but it definitely has representational content
